segments.text: I cloned my own voice with 10 seconds of audio,
then I called my own number.
The person who picked up sounded exactly like me.
I uploaded a short clip of myself,
typed a script the AI had never heard,
hit generate, and what came back was my voice, saying
words I never said.
So yes, it works.
And if you have a voice,
you should probably pay attention where it ends up.
